releases.name: Shrek 2 Remastered
releases.summary:
DreamWorks Shrek 2 Remastered: The cult-classic, button-mashing co-op adventure is back with all your favorite characters and improved graphics.

Journey through the fairytale kingdom of Far Far Away from Shrek’s swamp to Fiona’s castle and everywhere in between, in a classic action-adventure experience inspired by the DreamWorks Animation movie. Play solo or with up to three friends in co-op, take control of your favorite Shrek heroes as you smash, throw and kick your way against iconic characters from the franchise.

Improved graphics: Everything has been rebuilt with better textures, enhanced UI, 4K resolution and cutscenes.

New features: Create timeless snapshots using the new Photo Mode and unlock cheats in Cheat Mode to make your playthrough a seamless experience.

Up to 4-player Couch Co-op, Online or Mixed: A cozy, team-based co-op action-adventure game, playable solo or up to 4-Player Couch Co-Op, Online Multiplayer, and Mixed Online Multiplayer & Couch Co-Op.

Immersive levels straight out of a fairytale: From Shrek’s swamp to the castle of Far Far Away, relive iconic moments from the movie featuring beloved characters and hidden Easter Eggs.

Swap heroes at any time: Swap your hero to battle enemies, conquer bosses, and solve environmental puzzles using their unique abilities to advance in the story.

releases.name: Hillthorn
releases.summary:
Only the foolish and the desperate attempt to wander the mazelike trails of Hillthorn. Even those who know their way may still stumble upon dangerous wildlife or a local villager’s piercing gaze. 

But a child has gone missing, time is in short supply, and you’re the one being tasked with unraveling the mountain’s secrets. 

Welcome to Hillthorn, a dark investigation game unlike any other, where the mystery unfolds without a single word spoken.

releases.name: Ova Magica
releases.summary:
Stardew Valley meets Pokemon! Experience a wholesome farm game inspired by the classics! Train cute blob creatures, take care of your farm and make friends with the people of Clover Town.

You can grow everything from normal crops, berry bushes, and fruit trees, to heart fruit, weird herbs, and mushrooms from other dimensions! From your harvest you can cook high-quality food for your blobs to help them grow healthy and strong.

In the world of Ova Magica, people live side by side with these cute creatures, and you can raise them to be strong, loyal friends and sidekicks! To make your blobs stronger, you must feed them well, pet them and use specific skills in battles.

releases.name: Monster Train 2: The Punished
releases.summary: Turn pain into power with The Punished, a new clan joining the fight in Monster Train 2! Led by Archus, Darkness Incarnate, The Punished introduce a new risk-reward play style built around damaging your own units, harnessing their suffering, and turning it against your enemies.

releases.name: Warhammer Survivors
releases.summary:
Warhammer Survivors is a fast-paced roguelite survivors' game, pitting a host of iconic Warhammer characters against endless hordes of enemies from multiple Warhammer factions. 

Developed by Auroch Digital (Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun) in partnership with Warhammer and poncle (Vampire Survivors), discover the universes of Warhammer 40,000 and Warhammer: Age of Sigmar in all its pixel glory in this new surviv-a-ton.

releases.name: Unpetrified: Echoes of Nature
releases.summary:
Unpetrified: Echoes of Nature is a peaceful and reflective experience, filled with meaningful collectibles, unique emotion-driven interactions, and environmental puzzles. The orchestral soundtrack emphasizes an intimate storyline of unlikely friendship, loss, and love.

Travel across vast, beautifully diverse landscapes, each seamlessly blending into the next, filled with unique flora and fauna waiting to be discovered. The progress you make is reflected in the vibrant flowers blooming on the Golem’s back. There are many secrets and collectibles to discover, making for a rewarding exploration experience.

Solve puzzles that shape the environment around you. Use the Golem’s abilities to interact with the world in creative ways, unlocking new paths and uncovering secrets. Hidden within the remnants of a lost civilization lies the means to reclaim and rejuvenate Nature.

releases.name: TANUKI: Pon's Summer
releases.summary:
The Tanuki Festival is just a month away, and the shrine is in disrepair. Follow Pon, a well meaning, if a bit lazy Tanuki with a part-time job at the Post Office, as he works to restore the shrine before summer ends.

Deliver packages, make friends, and get the shrine ready for the big festival!

releases.name: MARVEL Cosmic Invasion: The Siege of Castle Doom
releases.summary: Welcome to MARVEL Cosmic Invasion - The Siege of Castle Doom, the second expansion of MARVEL Cosmic Invasion, which includes two new playable characters and a new game mode. Equipped with high-powered tech armor of his own design, along with occult skills and his genius intellect, Doctor Doom is the biggest threat in the universe... and Annihilus definitely won't be up to the challenge. Cosmic rays have given archeologist and explorer Susan Storm massive light-bending powers and force field manipulation. She now fights for the survival of the galaxy as The Invisible Woman, bringing in never-seen-before abilities to MARVEL Cosmic Invasion.

releases.name: Paths of Fight: Samurai
releases.summary: Find the correct fighting sequence to slice all your enemies. Finish them with powerful combos. Plan your moves and don't get stuck in a dead end in this action puzzle game themed in japan feudal era.

releases.name: BACKROOMS TOGETHER: SURVIVAL ESCAPE
releases.summary:
Every step takes you deeper into the unknown.

Enter the endless maze of liminal spaces, where abandoned corridors, empty rooms, and flickering lights hide unsettling mysteries and unexpected dangers. In this eerie world, finding the way out is only the beginning of your struggle to survive.

Backrooms Together: Survival Escape is a cooperative survival adventure where you and your teammates must explore strange environments, overcome dangerous encounters, and search for an escape route. Stay alert, watch your surroundings, and work together to avoid getting lost in the endless maze.

Explore mysterious levels filled with winding corridors, deserted rooms, and unsettling silence. Every location presents new challenges, and one wrong turn can put your entire team in danger. Pay attention to your surroundings and think carefully before moving forward.

To help you survive, the company provides every explorer with three essential tools: a protective hazmat suit, a pistol, and a flashlight. Use your suit for protection, illuminate dark passages with your flashlight, and keep your pistol ready when threats stand in your way.

However, equipment alone is not enough to guarantee survival. Communication, teamwork, and trust are essential when navigating unpredictable environments. Coordinate your movements, help your teammates overcome obstacles, and make every decision count as you search for a way out.

releases.name: Big Jhow Jet
releases.summary:
Prepare for takeoff! Strap on your homemade jetpack, defy gravity, and unleash total chaos to save your friends from the dreaded Bacon Factory!

Jhow is a brilliant, tech-obsessed piglet whose peaceful farm life is shattered when an ominous corporate truck kidnaps all his friends.

Refusing to be tomorrow's breakfast, Jhow heads to his secret workshop, fires up his custom-built jetpack, and takes to the skies as the ultimate high-speed hero: Big Jhow Jet!

In this frantic, physics-driven action-arcade game, momentum is everything. Blast out of a cannon and navigate a sky filled with targeted missiles, pigeon bombers, and ground-patrolling Bacon-Bots.

Manage your fuel, bounce off the asphalt, and master aerodynamics to reach maximum velocity.

Out of gas? The run isn't over! Use your last breath to initiate a heroic on-foot Sprint Dash, or rely on crazy power-ups and loyal helpers to keep the flight going!

releases.name: Pretty Girls Game Collection V
releases.summary:
The latest entry in the popular compilation series brings together four fan-favourite Pretty Girls titles in one value-packed retail release, offering players a diverse selection of puzzle and casual gameplay experiences paired with the charming anime-style presentation that fans have come to expect from the franchise.

Each of the four games has been enhanced with exclusive naughty content, that fans of the series have become accustomed to, amounting to a wealth of new images direct from the Japanese creators that would otherwise not have been possible to release on console even in their home country, making this essential and definitive.

releases.name: Chained Cars
releases.summary:
Can you master the chaos and conquer every track?

Chained Cars is an adrenaline-pumping video game where players control a series of cars linked together by a chain. The goal of the game is to navigate through various obstacles and traps, keeping in mind that all vehicles move simultaneously and must be carefully managed.

As you progress, the difficulty increases, and the tracks become more complex, with new challenges such as moving obstacles, tight corners, and dangerous jumps. The game emphasizes quick reflexes, strategy, and movement coordination to avoid collisions, overcome difficult sections, and go as far as possible.

Features:
-Innovative controls: The cars are linked together, and movements must be carefully coordinated to avoid crashes.
-Challenging tracks: Increasingly difficult levels with dynamic obstacles that require quick thinking and reactions.
-Vibrant graphics: The colorful and detailed design adds extra excitement to the gameplay.
-Progression: Difficulty increases as you advance in the game, with new features and tougher challenges.
-Balance and strategy challenges: Precise control of the cars is essential for success, requiring both skill and careful planning.

In the end, Chained Cars combines speed, strategy, and thrilling challenges, offering an engaging experience for players who enjoy games that push their limits and test their abilities in exciting ways.

releases.name: Neon GT Racing
releases.summary: Neon GT Racing throws you onto neon-lit circuits at full throttle. Pick your GT car, nail the racing line, and fight your way from the back of the grid to the top of the podium.Your rivals never make it easy. They overtake, dodge obstacles, and bounce straight back from every crash, so each lap stays tight until the checkered flag.Drive it your way: arcade handling for instant drift-and-go thrills, or realistic handling where every braking point counts.FeaturesPowerful GT cars with sharp, responsive handlingNeon-lit tracks with real-time reflectionsAggressive AI rivals that overtake and recover from crashesArcade or realistic driving stylesMulti-lap races against a full gridInstant respawn to keep you in the action

releases.name: Climb the Tsunami Obby
releases.summary:
Can you climb your way to the top?

In Climb the Tsunami Obby, parkour your way up a massive tsunami wave while overcoming challenging obstacles and tricky jumps. Reach the top and prove your platforming skills!

With multiple levels, checkpoints, and a Hardcore Mode for those looking for a true challenge, there is always another climb to conquer!

releases.name: Mad Cat
releases.summary:
Forget about purring on laps or napping in sunbeams. In Mad Cat, you play as a wild cat. This feline has had enough of being a polite house pet. Your owner just wants a tidy, peaceful home, but you are here to turn every room into your personal scratch post and demolition playground. Experience the world from a floor-level cat's perspective, complete with nimble paws, sharp claws, and zero regrets.

Your goal is simple: cause non-stop household disasters without getting caught. Dash through the living room. Jump onto high shelves and knock fragile vases off ledges. Tear the couch fabric and grab fresh sausages from the kitchen counter. 

Every broken plate and spilled drink adds to your chaos meter. This sparks funny reactions from the girl and frightens her household dog. When you are done trashing the indoor rooms, slip outside. 

Earn chaos points to unlock unique cat breeds, silly accessories, and new styles to keep the domestic mayhem going!

releases.name: Jetpack Hero Rush
releases.summary:
Jump, fly, and shoot your way through an action-packed city adventure!

Use your jetpack to soar over dangerous obstacles, dodge deadly spikes, and blast enemies as you race across colorful rooftops. Collect golden coins, survive challenging platform sections, and travel as far as you can!

How far can you go? Gear up, take aim, and survive the ultimate rooftop adventure!

releases.name: Fisherman's House
releases.summary:
You have been mysteriously captured by the terrifying fisherman. The fisherman is famous for kidnapping his victims to eat them afterwards. Your mission? To escape as quickly as possible before the fisherman hatches you.

The fisherman's house is awaiting you inside this game, in this house there are all sorts of tools and keys that can help you to escape from the house. But you should be careful because the fisherman hears very precisely.

releases.name: Hasbro Games Junior Collection
releases.summary:
Get ready for a big, colorful game night full of laughs, surprises, and “just one more turn!” moments! This collection brings 3 classic junior board games to life in one exciting video game made for kids and families.

Race around the board in Monopoly Jr., where every dice roll can help you grab cool places, collect money, and become the last player standing. Put on your detective hat in Clue Jr. as you search for clues, cross off suspects, and solve the case before anyone else! Then jump into The Game of Life Jr., spin the spinner, drive your car along the path, and collect stars as you go.

Play on your own or in local multiplayer for up to 4 players on one console. Create your own adorable avatar and make it truly yours with fun customization options and unlock new looks and cosmetic rewards just by playing matches.

Easy to learn and packed with exciting moments every round, it’s perfect for family game nights, friendly competition, and big smiles from start to finish!

releases.name: K-POP Rising: Dream to Shine
releases.summary: In K-POP Rising: Dream to Shine, players immerse themselves in the demanding and fascinating world of modern music. Accompanied by their best friend Nova, they will need to commit 100 percent to the race for stardom: from intensive training sessions in the studio to the ultimate recognition on the most prestigious stages, the title offers a complete experience combining a sense of rhythm, deep customization, and community management in the era of social media.

releases.name: Billionaire Secret Affaire: Forbidden Desire Boys
releases.summary:
In public, their lives look perfect.
Tailored suits, quiet fortunes, and men who always seem in control.

Behind closed doors, things are different.
A handshake that lasts a moment longer than it should.
A private message sent late at night.
A man who built an empire on keeping secrets… and is about to trust you with his.

In Billionaire Secret Affair: Forbidden Desire Boys, you enter an adult story about attraction between men who can't afford to be seen, and the connection that grows anyway.

These are men with names to protect. Investors, heirs, and founders who learned early that every feeling has a cost. Getting close means reading what they don't say and offering the honesty they never find anywhere else.

Every choice matters. A careful word can open a door they've kept locked for years. A careless one can send them back behind the mask for good.

Closeness grows in small, private moments. A drink after everyone leaves. A confession nobody else hears. The feeling of finally being chosen.

As the days pass, the pressure builds, reputations hang in the balance, and each man has to decide what he's willing to risk. Not every path ends in love, and not every story ends the same way.

A visual novel about desire, discretion, and the courage it takes to want someone out loud.

releases.name: Billionaire Secret Affaire: Forbidden Desire Girls
releases.summary:
Powerful women. Private rules. A secret only you can keep.

From the outside, their world looks untouchable.
Glass penthouses, private galas, and women who never lose their composure.

But power has its cracks.
A look that stays on you a little too long.
An invitation nobody else received.
A smile that says she's used to getting what she wants… and tonight, that might be you.

In Billionaire Secret Affaire: Forbidden Desire Girls, you're pulled into an adult story about attraction, discretion, and the price of getting too close to the wrong person.

These women run companies, fortunes, and reputations. They don't do anything by accident. Catching their attention is one thing. Keeping it without getting burned is another.

Every conversation is a test. Say too much and the door closes. Say too little and someone else takes your place. The right words at the right moment can turn a polite exchange into something neither of you can talk about in public.

Trust is earned slowly, in stolen moments and conversations that end before anyone notices.

releases.name: EGGCONSOLE Harry Fox MSX Special MSX
releases.summary:
A mother fox's touching story now features 2D map exploration, 3D dungeons, and RPG combat. More than a port, it feels brand-new!

This title is an adventure game originally released by Microcabin in 1986. While retaining the touching core story—a mother fox setting off toward the distant Reel Shrine in search of fried tofu (abura-age), rumored to be a miracle cure for her terminally ill kit—this unique MSX arranged port drastically overhauls the original gameplay systems.

The game has evolved into a deeply engaging, RPG-like experience. Controls have been updated to a user-friendly, command-selection menu, allowing players to freely explore a 2D scrolling world map. The addition of perspective-shifting 3D dungeon exploration further enhances the sense of immersion.

Free movement across the map brings a substantial increase in narrative content along the journey. Alongside traditional RPG elements such as health points (HP) and battles against wild animals, a dynamic day-night cycle has been introduced. This makes room for numerous new side quests and events, including time-sensitive occurrences, conversations with quirky animal inhabitants, and requests from NPCs.

While faithfully preserving the gentle, heartwarming atmosphere of the original fairy-tale fantasy, the integration of open exploration, combat, and varied events turns it into a livelier, action-oriented adventure. Transcending the boundaries of a standard port, this charming classic offers a fresh experience that feels almost entirely brand-new.

releases.name: Phantom Floor
releases.summary:
You are trapped on the Phantom Floor. 

You must find a way to escape, but keep quiet, it's always listening.

releases.name: Thrift Store Treasure Hidden Objects
releases.summary: Dig through dusty racks and cluttered shelves in Thrift Store Treasure, a cozy hidden object game packed with quirky finds, satisfying puzzles, and charming customers to serve.

releases.name: Weak Zombie: Rescue Friends
releases.summary:
Endless hordes of zombies, and friends trapped all over the place.
Become a zombie who may be weak but never gives up, and set out to rescue your friends!

■ A survival roguelite where you mow down zombie hordes
Explore stages while taking down the zombie hordes closing in from every direction.
Every run unfolds differently—your goal is to survive.

■ Rescue friends and unlock new characters
Find and rescue the friends trapped in each stage.
Rescued friends become new playable characters you can choose from your next run onward.

■ Unique weapons and abilities for every character
Each friend has their own unique weapon and abilities.
Switch characters and enjoy a whole new style of combat every time.

■ A rhythm action mode powered by the music you collect
Take on a standalone rhythm action mode using music earned or purchased in the game.
Hit the notes to the beat and discover a whole different kind of fun.

releases.name: 1x1 Street Football: mini soccer PvP
releases.summary: Fast-paced 1v1 street soccer arcade game! Control unique heroes, use spectacular combat-style moves, and defeat opponents in real-time. Upgrade your characters' skills, conquer global leagues, and become a superstar in thrilling online PvP football matches

releases.name: GET FIT - Street Workout
releases.summary:
Train with pro trainers, push your limits, and get stronger with every session! Choose your trainer, level, and routine - then jump into 30 minutes of intense full-body workout.

Turn fitness into a fun, motivating, and interactive experience.

Choose your personal trainer, select your level, and begin your custom fitness journey through structured workouts that keep you challenged and inspired.

Each session combines 7 different exercises, performed for 1 minute 30 seconds with short 30-second breaks — repeated twice for a full 28-minute workout plus warm-up. With over 100 exercises, there are endless variations to keep every session fresh.

Build your personal training schedule across weeks or months, earn rewards for staying consistent, and watch your strength and endurance grow. Each trainer brings unique energy, voice, and encouragement to help you stay motivated.

releases.name: TIDEBREAK
releases.summary: Wake up on an island the sea swallows a little more every night. Punch trees, craft, build a camp, fish, and hold out against what crawls out of the water. Three bosses, a Beacon, one way home. Solo or with two friends.

releases.name: Play & Learn My First Korean
releases.summary:
See it. Fill in Hangul!

Can you recognize the right Korean word from a picture and its meaning?

If you are just starting out, learning a new language can feel intimidating. This game makes your first steps into Korean simple and fun.

Complete Korean words by filling in the blank with the correct Hangul. Illustrations and Japanese meanings help you understand familiar everyday words as you play.

How to play:
• Check the illustration and the Japanese meaning.
• Choose the correct Hangul from the answer choices.
• Complete the Korean word in the blank.

With 120 stages to play, you can gradually get used to Hangul letters and Korean vocabulary through a fun game-like experience.

Recommended for anyone who:
• Wants to start learning Korean
• Wants to learn Hangul in a fun way
• Wants to get familiar with Korean words
• Enjoys quizzes and fill-in-the-blank puzzles
• Wants to practice a language in short sessions

releases.name: Next of Kin: Epiphany
releases.summary: Become private detective Dennis Monroe, a relentless investigator driven to catch the infamous "Epiphany Killer," a shadowy figure who has haunted the city for over twenty years. Every clue draws you closer to the truth, but danger lurks behind every revelation.

releases.name: Zeus Evolve Weapons Survivor: Greek Gods Versus Heaven
releases.summary:
He built heaven. Now heaven wants him gone. Play as Zeus and survive the war he started!

Olympus has turned on its king.

Endless waves of divine soldiers, mythic beasts, and rival gods close in from every side, and they do not stop.

You are Zeus, the most powerful god in the Greek pantheon, walking alone through the kingdom he built as the sky itself turns against him.

Pick up weapons. Evolve them. Destroy everything.

releases.name: Sora - Oasis Treasures
releases.summary:
Embark on a breathtaking journey through the jungle skies in Sora - Oasis Treasures. Play as a vibrant parrot and soar across tropical islands, dense canopies, waterfalls, and ancient ruins. Your goal is simple yet meaningful: stay close to your flock as you all travel across the wild, untouched archipelago. 

Each of the handcrafted levels features 40–60 sky markers guiding your path as your flock leads the way. Fly through wind boosts to gain speed, discover hidden shortcuts, and enjoy the feeling of freedom as you glide above treetops and turquoise waters. The world is full of life and color, rewarding you with beautiful vistas and relaxing moments of harmony in flight. 
Though the skies are peaceful, you must stay alert—fall too far behind, and you risk losing the flock. Crashes don’t punish you harshly; you simply return to the most recent waypoint and continue your journey. The focus is on enjoying the adventure, soaking in the serene atmosphere, and experiencing the thrill of flying together. 

With smooth controls, gentle pacing, and vibrant flocks that vary in speed each run, every flight feels fresh. Whether you're racing through the breeze or drifting lazily over a jungle river, Sora - Oasis Treasures offers a warm, relaxing escape into tropical skies where unity and exploration take center stage

releases.name: FlipFlip Jigsaw DOUBLE-SIDE PUZZLE
releases.summary:
Clear Both Sides♪ A New Double-Sided Flip Puzzle Featuring a Variety of Illustrations!

In addition to classic jigsaw puzzle gameplay, challenge yourself with a unique puzzle experience combining Rotate and Flip mechanics!
Featuring a variety of illustrations, including cute girls and adorable animals♪ Take your time, enjoy the artwork, and complete each puzzle at your own pace!
15 stages included!
As you progress, new mechanics and larger piece counts increase the challenge!
• Stages 1–5: Rotate Puzzles
• Stages 6–10: Double-Sided Flip Puzzles
• Stages 11–15: Double-Sided Flip + Rotate Puzzles
• Includes high-difficulty stages with up to 81 pieces × 2 sides!
In double-sided stages, you can complete either the front side or the back side first! How you solve each puzzle is entirely up to you♪
The final stage is an ultimate challenge with no background watermark hints! Carefully examine every piece and work your way toward completion!
A gallery featuring both front-side and back-side artwork is unlocked as you complete puzzles! Clear every stage and complete the entire gallery collection!

releases.name: BREACHCAM
releases.summary:
EVERY BREACH IS RECORDED

BREACHCAM puts you behind the lens of a body camera worn into the fight. There is nothing clean between you and what happens: the picture bends at the edges, the sensor grains up in the dark, the frame swings with every step, and the recording marker never leaves the corner.

SIX PLACES, SIX MOODS

A hangar and a yard in flat daylight. Abandoned streets under a grey sky. Container stacks at sunset. A forest road in fog. Rail tracks and tankers in the snow at dawn. A warehouse of racks and catwalks at night.

Each one is its own deployment, with its own light, weather and layout, and you choose where to go.

CLOSE AND LOUD

You arrive carrying everything you need — rifles, a shotgun, a sidearm, grenades and a blade — so the fight starts the moment you step in. Enemy squads hold the ground, take cover and push you back when you let them, and the whole thing plays out in seconds at a distance you can measure in steps.

A RECORDING, NOT A REPORT

No maps, no markers, no briefings. Just the camera, the room in front of you, and whatever the lens catches.

releases.name: Dungeon of Dragon Knight Remake
releases.summary:
Dungeon Of Dragon Knight Remake
Step into a forgotten dungeon, where the echoes of ancient wars still linger. The legend of the Dragon Knight lies buried beneath its stones—and so does the Artifact that once kept the darkness at bay.

Classic Dungeon Crawling, Reborn
Dungeon Of Dragon Knight Remake is a first-person, grid-based, real-time combat dungeon crawler RPG that faithfully revives the essence of classic old-school dungeon exploration. Navigate each corridor step by step, feel the tension of every corner, and strike fast in real-time combat.

Build Your Party
Assemble a four-person adventuring party from a variety of classes and races. Each character brings unique abilities and growth paths, and every choice you make shapes your party’s combat style and exploration strategy.

Exploration and Puzzles Intertwined
This dungeon is not just a battleground—it is a massive puzzle box. Hidden switches, ancient carvings, scattered letters… every detail may hold the key to the next floor, or reveal a secret long buried beneath the stone.

The Dragon Knight’s Legacy
Legend says the Dragon Knight used the Artifact to seal the darkness beneath the dungeon. Now the Artifact is stolen, and the darkness is rising. Lured into the dungeon by a witch, you must find the Artifact before the dungeon claims you—and uncover the truth before it is lost forever.

releases.name: Sleepless Night Mysteries: Unsolved Case Files
releases.summary:
Can you crack these mysteries?

What secrets are waiting at the scene?

If you enjoy detective stories but want something easy to pick up, this mystery game lets anyone feel like a real investigator.

Search through unsolved cases, uncover hidden evidence, and piece together what really happened. Every case is a self-contained short story, so you can enjoy a complete mystery whenever you have a little time.

• Examine each scene carefully
• Find the evidence hidden in the case
• Use hints when you need a helping hand
• Follow the clues and reveal the truth

Helpful hints make the game welcoming for newcomers to mysteries and deduction, while careful observers can test their skills from the very first case.

Enjoy a quick mystery break, challenge your powers of observation, and try to solve each case before the answer comes to light!

releases.name: Don Bradman Cricket Jr
releases.summary: FAST. FUN. CRICKET! Step onto the pitch and feel the thrill of every shot. Don Bradman Cricket Jr is fast, accessible cricket that's easy to learn and rewarding to master. Smash boundaries, outplay opponents and make every run count.

releases.name: Frutageddon Fruit Platformer
releases.summary:
Jump, shoot, and swing through unruly fruits and vegetables. Blend enemy remains into power-ups in this side-scrolling action-platformer.

The food has risen up. Time to fight back! In Frutageddon: The Fruit Platformer, play as a resistance chef taking on rogue fruits and vegetables in a post-apocalyptic future. Get ready for a side-scrolling 2D action-platformer packed with culinary humor.
Combine melee attacks with ranged attacks to blast your way through. Double jump, use your grappling hook, and swing between platforms as you battle the food that's turned against humanity.
Leftovers? Into the juice jug! Turn enemy scraps into power-ups and keep the culinary battle going.
Travel through six regions and face their bosses.

releases.name: Adventure of Kanjiro Chapter 3
releases.summary:
Let's go on an adventure for those who have lost their kanji!

"Adventure of Kanjiro" is a game of kanji learning, so that children who are not good at kanji or dislike practicing kanji can learn kanji while having fun.

As Kanjiro, the main character of this work, you will discover kanji stolen by monsters by writing kanji, looking for kanji, and looking for reading. By discovering kanji, you can raise your level and earn coins.
You can use coins to buy items such as equipment and potions at the shop to prepare to fight monsters.
In battles with monsters, the faster you remember the kanji you find, the more damage you can do. However, if you remember incorrectly, you will be damaged instead.
In order to defeat monsters, it is important not only to have good items, but also to remember the kanji well.

Let's enjoy the game and memorize the kanji so that we can defeat all the monsters and get back the kanji!

Features Kanji taught in 3rd grade of Japanese elementary school.

releases.name: Circuit Puzzle - Brain Training: Connect the Wires -
releases.summary:
Rotate the tiles. Complete the circuit!

Can you bring a scrambled circuit back to life?

Remember those simple puzzles that looked easy until you tried them? This time, a circuit board is your playground in a satisfying rotation puzzle that is easy to learn and tricky to master.

Rotate tiles covered with wires until every connection lines up correctly. One turn at a time, restore the circuit and watch the electronic board come together.

How to play:
• Observe the circuit board design
• Rotate the tiles to change their direction
• Connect the wires correctly and complete the circuit

The rules are simple, but finding the right direction takes careful observation and a spark of intuition. Seeing scattered wires join into a complete circuit delivers a wonderfully satisfying finish.

Whether you enjoy testing your focus and problem-solving skills or just want a quick brain-training break, this puzzle is a welcoming choice for beginners and experienced players alike.

Rotate each tile and bring the circuit back to life!

releases.name: Curse of Resthaven
releases.summary:
Take command of the cursed island colony of Resthaven after your niece disappears on the eve of a catastrophe. You must govern the town, allocate resources wisely, and decide who... or what... to trust.

Trade and haggle with visiting merchants, upgrade businesses, and interrogate townsfolk who guard their secrets closely. Every decision will impact the colony’s prosperity and unlock new leads, opportunities, and risks.

Multiple major narrative paths and randomized expeditions ensure that each playthrough exposes different pieces of the puzzle. Only by mastering the game’s systems and winning over the people of Resthaven can you hope to break the curse.

releases.name: Eternal Palace Sakura
releases.summary: Sharpen your blades and step into the Eternal Palace Sakura, a dream labyrinth haunted by restless yokai. Battle through ever-shifting realms in this anime-inspired 3D action roguelite, mastering fluid combat and exploring endless floors of the palace!

releases.name: Faraway
releases.summary: You are a shooting star that refuses its fate of disappearing in the ether, to instead go travel space and draw constellations through its journey. Faraway is a one-button game, with a simple set of rules finely balanced to adapt to different playing levels, within an always renewed universe that is procedurally generated in real time - based on score -, resulting in an infinitely replayable game. Like Steph Thirion's first game Eliss, Faraway is set in a bizarre and lonely outer space, was 100% created - design, coding, music and sound - by one person, and all its graphics are drawn by code, resulting in a rarely personal sensory experience.

releases.name: Binary Guardian
releases.summary:
Protect the 0 in a minimalist puzzle game built around the language of binary code. Your goal is simple: keep the zero safe from incoming 1s and guide it toward its destination.

Each level challenges you to think ahead, react carefully, and choose the safest route through an increasingly dangerous digital environment. Watch how the ones move, plan your path, and avoid getting trapped as you make your way toward the goal.

The rules are easy to understand, but the puzzles become more demanding as new layouts and threats appear. Success depends on timing, positioning, and logical thinking rather than speed alone.

Enter a clean digital world where every 0 and 1 matters, and prove that you can protect the most important bit.

releases.name: Find My Panties
releases.summary:
Dive into a colorful and entertaining hidden object game where your main goal is to find all the hidden panties!

Explore detailed locations filled with a wide variety of objects. Panties can be hidden anywhere - among furniture, clothes, decorations, plants, and everyday items. Carefully examine every corner of each scene, as some hidden items are surprisingly tricky to spot!

Complete levels, discover hidden objects, and unlock beautiful new images featuring charming anime girls in a special gallery. Build your collection and enjoy stunning illustrations!

Each level offers a new scene, interesting details, and cleverly hidden objects. Test your observation skills, sharpen your attention to detail, and enjoy relaxing gameplay without any rush.

releases.name: Needle In A Haystack 2026
releases.summary:
Pull the straws. Sell the hay. Hire a crew, grab a rake. Find the needle in the haystack!

Somewhere in this haystack there is a needle. Your job is to find it, one straw at a time.

Needle In A Haystack 2026 is a relaxing first-person idle game set in a huge factory hall. Grab straws from the pile, drop them on the conveyor belt and watch the money roll in. Every straw you sell brings you closer to the needle hidden deep inside the stack.

Start small with your bare hands and the little Backyard Stack. Spend your earnings in the Workshop to carry more straws at once, get a better price for every straw and hire workers who dig through the hay while you search for the needle. When you are ready, take on The Great Haystack - a towering dome of more than 26,000 straws.

UPGRADE YOUR TOOLS
- Bigger hands: carry more straws on every trip
- Better buyer: earn more money for every straw
- Rake: sweep up a whole bunch of straws with one stroke
- Vacuum cleaner: suck straws straight out of the pile
- Metal detector: scan through the hay and listen for the needle. At the top level, an arrow points the way

releases.name: Dominus Gladiatus
releases.summary: Build your Ludus. Train gladiators. Fight for glory. Dominus Gladiatus is a brutal gladiator management simulator where you recruit, train and equip gladiators before sending them into the arenas of ancient Rome.
